cohort: Pregnant women at or beyond 20 weeks of gestation with laboratory-confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection in Bahia, Brazil, between 2020 and 2022.
finding: The overall case fatality rate for SARS-CoV-2 infection among pregnant women in Bahia, Brazil, was 2.2%, with social, clinical, and healthcare access factors significantly influencing maternal deaths.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was identified as an independent predictor of maternal death among pregnant women with SARS-CoV-2 infection.
gest_age: at or beyond 20 weeks of gestation
